Action: ## Enter article references
Go to the "Enter Article Metadata" tab in the "Publisher Area"
Find the "References" field

Expected Test Results: The field is a multi-line textarea, with the help text "One reference per line"
The field is optional, so no error is shown for it when the form is submitted empty

Action: Fill in the required fields (title, one author, Full-Text URL, Print and Online ISSNs) for a new article

Enter the following 3 lines in the "References" field: "Smith, J. (2020) A reference with a DOI. doi:10.1234/abc", "Jones, A. (2021) A reference with a URL. https://www.doaj.org/" and "Brown, B. (2022) A reference with no identifier."
Enter a 4th line containing a script tag, eg "<script>alert(1)</script>"
Click "Add Article" button

Expected Test Results: Red error message under the "References" field: Value cannot contain script tag
The article is not created

Action: Remove the line containing the script tag
Click "Add Article" button

Expected Test Results: At the top of the page you see the confirmation message:  Article created/updated (Dismiss)

Action: Open the public page of the article you have just created

Expected Test Results: A "References" section is shown with the 3 references as a numbered list, in the order you entered them
The DOI in the first reference and the URL in the second reference are links, and they open in a new tab
The third reference contains no links
